# Attribution and scope

This new eight-pivot construction, its deterministic orchestration and its additional omission controls were prepared for eumemic with OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0 applies; the license is included. No claim of independent human authorship, Lean verification, or an unconditional all-size multiplication theorem is made.

The unchanged reconstruction and admission dependencies are copied from [PR552](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/552), commit `33c33af0b7697155be1ea708e08cbd3f0707d94c`, package `research/filtration-wavefront`. Its complete 105-file source package is retained, including the historical notices, proofs, AI disclosures, source pins and license. The package credits earlier work by DreamingOfClouds with Claude Opus 5.5 through Claude Code, and work by icekylinx with OpenAI Codex assistance; those credits are not replaced by this notice.

The complete phase compiler driver `code/phases_full.py` is copied unchanged from [PR551](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/551), commit `e7faafc4fec401d24080e5b2df12f964f1cfe123`, with its original attribution retained. Other phase and global admission sources remain the pinned PR552 vendored versions of the earlier PR531/PR535 lineage.

The cited bit supplier is [PR543](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/543), commit `2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535`. Its published exact receipt is an explicit dependency. This package's verifier rebuilds the changed complex supplier; it does not claim a fresh bit replay.

`SOURCE-PINS.json` records copied upstream paths, commits, SHA-256 digests and Git blob identifiers. Unmodified source files remain byte-for-byte copies. The final package manifest also covers the new construction, owner plan and scripts. Prior published PR heads and claims are preserved.

The hardened assembly and admission controls are adapted from eumemic/Codex PR550, head `c7337040822978f1611ce9d9d44e7bb96d887e23`; the finite-parameter choice uses the retained PR275 finite-frontier method. Source hashes and changes are recorded in `proof/ASSEMBLY-PROVENANCE.json`.
